name: Follow Amber
author: Brett
description: One switch: Follow Amber. On: whenever Amber (any Claude session through the console's MCP or axHub) mentions a console screen, settings tab, dialog or anything that needs you, she calls console_show and the console opens it right away, focused and highlighted, with what she said as a note; and every axHub held or confirm call for you pops up in the console as an approval dialog (title, plain description, the exact call folded away, the countdown on veto calls, big Approve and Deny that act on one tap, a queue when there are several). Decisions stay in the console: a tap goes to axHub through the approvals banner's relay with your own signed-in hub session, and the result shows in the pop-up; the console never approves anything by itself. Off: nothing opens by itself and approvals stay in the approvals banner. Switch it in Settings → Plugins → Follow Amber, the right-click menu anywhere in the console, or the banner chip. Showing only navigates (it runs with the navigate permission alone), so it never waits on a veto. REST /api/plugins/follow-amber (state, show, approval, stream), MCP console_show and console_follow, CLI axf follow-amber <command>.
